QuestInfo.name: Rise of the Alliance
QuestInfo.0: The Empress's tactician, #p1101002#, has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1: Empress #p1101000# has called her knights to meet with her. Head to #m130000000#.\n
QuestInfo.2: Empress #p1101000# realizes that the Cygnus Knights can't protect Maple World on their own. She has decided to call for an Alliance between all the people of Maple World.

0.0: I see your training is coming along nicely, #h0#. However, while you've been adventuring across Maple World, the Empress has been here, worrying about several grave matters.
0.1: It's time for her to make an important decision. Before she does so, she seeks the counsel of each of her knights. You are to return to #m130000000# immediately.

yes.0: The Empress has been quite stressed as of late. Please, don't keep her waiting.

no.0: This is an order, not a request. As a Cygnus Knight, you are to report to the Empress immediately. I don't care how busy you are!

1.0: Welcome, #b#h0##k.\rI have something important to ask of you. The Cygnus Knights have always battled the forces of the Black Mage alone. After all, I believed that we had to stand by our own power.
1.1: But now I realize that our power alone is not enough. I am weak, and I see that the world won't always be able to rely on us. We need help.
1.2: This won't be easy, but I see no other option. I've already asked the Explorers, Resistance, and awakened Heroes for help, and made a great deal of progress in making them understand the situation.

yes.0: The time for action has come. I shall hold a continental conference, with the express purpose of forming a Maple Alliance. As a Cygnus Knight, you should prepare well for this event.

npc.0: The Empress has been quite stressed as of late. Please, don't keep her waiting.
